info.description: Search-engine and social-share overrides. Every field is optional — leave blank to use the page's own content.

metaTitle.description: Overrides the browser/search title. Aim for 50-60 characters.

metaDescription.description: Overrides the search snippet. Aim for 140-160 characters.

ogImage.description: Social share image. 1200x630. Falls back to the auto-generated card.

canonicalURL.description: Only set this when the same content lives at another URL that should rank instead.

noIndex.description: Hide this page from search engines.
